name: Steadfast
overview: Scripture reveals that being steadfast involves a heart fixed on trusting the LORD, remaining sober, temperate, and patient amid trials and temptations. Those who wait on the LORD are renewed in strength and able to endure without fainting, as seen in the promise of the crown of life to those who persevere in love. This steadfastness reflects both a disciplined faith and the experience of God’s enduring, steadfast love that sustains believers through challenges.
